name: dev-hooks
description: Polyglot dev-workflow hooks for Claude Code: auto-lint on edit, verify tests/linters before stopping, a PreToolUse dangerous-command guard, per-prompt JSONL logging (plus opt-in per-hook fire telemetry via DEV_HOOKS_FIRE_LOG) that feeds the weekly automation review's add/retire passes, a per-prompt intent-check that nudges Claude to restate the goal and non-goals when a task prompt says what to do but not why or what's out of scope, and reminder hooks for plaintext secrets, leftover debug statements, leftover TODO/FIXME markers, missing tests, stack-aware skills, multi-session plans, review-before-finishing, verbose comments added this session, end-of-session memory capture, dev-env-standard gaps, Dockerfile layer ordering (hadolint on write), popover/tooltip positioning, database-migration safety (reversibility/backfill/lock-aware DDL), web accessibility gaps (alt/labels/keyboard), string-interpolated SQL injection, swallowed exceptions, GitHub Actions supply-chain security (SHA-pinning + ref resolution), watching the CI run after a git push, inline-SVG-to-icon-library, use-the-framework-generator scaffolding, outdated dependency pins, large uncommitted changes, a plain-language per-file change summary before finishing, and a self-stocking/self-advertising personal CLI-script library (SessionStart index of your saved tools + end-of-session nudge to keep reusable one-offs). Ships the companion skills the hooks point at: dev-env-setup (mise + hk + CI + gitleaks + zizmor & actionlint GitHub Actions checks + project-docs standard, version-tracked, with a fleet mode that discovers every stamped repo via fleet_roster.sh and backfills them after a bump), github-actions (workflow supply-chain security checklist + actionlint & zizmor static analysis + fleet-wide SHA-pin/bump), dependency-upgrade (bump JS/Ruby/Python/Actions deps to latest with changelog-aware major handling and test-gated incremental commits), env-to-fnox (migrate plaintext .env secrets to fnox, with an optional migrate_env_to_fnox.py automation for the Bitwarden Secrets Manager default), dockerfile (cache-friendly layer ordering + gotchas), popovers-tooltips (collision-aware positioning with Floating UI in a Stimulus controller, plus Tippy/Flowbite/native Popover API), accessibility (on-demand WCAG 2.2/ARIA audit of changed frontend files with a heuristic a11y_audit.py, plus Rails/Hotwire + React fixes), tailwind (design tokens, taming class soup via component extraction, dark mode, responsive, and accessibility), worktree-setup (provision a freshly-created git worktree: trust its mise.toml, copy gitignored secrets/config like Rails master.key and .env from the main checkout, and re-mark shebang scripts executable, plus opt-in per-worktree port+database isolation via a committed .worktree-isolate.conf so parallel worktrees don't collide), compress-comments (review the comments a session's work added and cut them down, delete-biased around one survival rule — a comment survives only if it states something the code cannot show — with docstrings compressed but never deleted and lint directives untouched), and repo-review (whole-repository severity-ranked audit across correctness, performance, smells, architecture, security, test health, dev-env, dependencies, CI supply-chain, secrets, and — for web repos — accessibility and docs; delegates to the specialist skills/commands and ships a read-only detect_stack.sh preflight; report-only, stack-agnostic counterpart to rails-audit), and script-library (genericize a one-off script into a standalone PEP 723 / uv-run CLI with a # short-description: line and save it to a library root — ~/.local/bin or a cloned, shareable scripts repo with subdirectories, configured via a PATH-style colon-separated DEV_HOOKS_SCRIPT_DIR — where the recursive script-index hook surfaces it next session), api-scraping (reverse-engineer the private JSON/GraphQL API behind a site instead of scraping HTML: gate on robots.txt/ToS, capture a HAR, find the data-carrying request with the bundled har_scan.py, minimize the request to only the headers/auth it needs, generate a paginating/rate-limited/resumable client, and escalate only as far as needed — headers → cookies/token → curl_cffi TLS impersonation → headless browser — stopping at CAPTCHAs), off-topic-improvements (drain a repo's plans/off-topic-improvements.md backlog: triage each parked item do-now/defer/drop, land each addressed item as its own atomic commit, and remove it from the file as it lands so the backlog stays a short live list), the standalone loop-oversight (before running an iterating loop — a /loop, a /schedule routine, or a Workflow fan-out — set up the three things that keep it reviewable: a canonical ledger, an explicit bound (max iterations / token budget / until-N-empty), and an independent verify pass that isn't the writing agent; picks the substrate by how closely you can watch and keeps unattended loops to PR-per-unit with no auto-merge), and agent-brief (write a task brief for an agent aimed at an outcome not a method: a fill-in-order GOAL/WHY/DONE-WHEN/DON'T/AUTONOMY/PROVE-IT skeleton with a near-empty method box, the companion teacher to the intent-check hook).
